trust_decision.summary: Whether an http/https URL named inside a loaded WSDL/XSD (xsd:import, xsd:include, wsdl:import, lxml resolver) may be fetched; the forbid_external setting exists but is never consulted at the pinned commit, so every transitive URL is fetched via transport.load.

landing_point.why: load_external is the single function that turns a schema/WSDL location into transport.load(url); an SSRF report on WSDL loading leads straight here (and to the unused forbid_external at src/zeep/settings.py:54).

fix_sites.entry_point: ImportResolver used by parse_xml, reached from Client(wsdl) loading and from SOAP response parsing (src/zeep/wsdl/bindings/soap.py:204)
zeep.loader.parse_xml (public helper; also SOAP response parsing)
zeep.loader.load_external; reached by Client(wsdl)->Document, xsd.Schema(node) via visitor import/include
Document._get_xml_document, shared by entry load and wsdl:import (src/zeep/wsdl/wsdl.py:282)
xsd.Schema.add_document_by_url (public) and auto-import of soap-encoding (src/zeep/xsd/schema.py:286-291), marked _initial

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/zeep/loader.py:93-110 (load_external_async, no in-tree callers) and src/zeep/loader.py:18-21 (lxml ImportResolver, also reached from SOAP response parsing src/zeep/wsdl/bindings/soap.py:204)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: load_external_async has no caller (AsyncTransport docstring says WSDL loading stays sync, src/zeep/transports.py:176-177) and ImportResolver sits on a parser with resolve_entities=False (src/zeep/loader.py:44), so a solver can argue neither is reachable.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The user-supplied entry-point WSDL/schema URL must still load when forbid_external=True (only transitive imports blocked), and the default must allow transitive loads (fix flips default True->False); a check placed in load_external without an initial/transitive distinction, or one that honours the pinned default True, breaks normal Client(wsdl) loading and existing multi-file WSDL tests.
O5_coupled_behaviour.where: src/zeep/wsdl/wsdl.py:88-89, src/zeep/wsdl/wsdl.py:282, src/zeep/settings.py:54, fix.diff:112-114, fix.diff:178-179, fix.diff:272-290

O6_input_shapes: wsdl:import location, both WSDL and bare-schema targets (src/zeep/wsdl/wsdl.py:282-287)
relative location resolved against an http base (src/zeep/loader.py:87-88, check after absolute_location at fix.diff:111-114)

O7_producer.where: src/zeep/settings.py:54 (forbid_external default) and the _initial flag threaded through src/zeep/wsdl/wsdl.py:88-89 / src/zeep/xsd/schema.py:119-120

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Transitive xsd:import/include or wsdl:import naming file:// or a bare local path is still loaded with forbid_external=True; Transport.load reads both, and the pinned setting doc promised 'remote or local resources'.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Advisory is SSRF (network); the published fix explicitly scopes the check and the new doc to http/https (fix.diff:113, fix.diff:162-163).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: _retrieve_data calling transport.load + parse_xml directly instead of load_external (e.g. to add per-document caching).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Visitor already owns its own fetch helper; inlining the two-line load is a natural refactor and bypasses the central check.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An async Document/Schema load path (AsyncClient) that calls load_external_async with _initial left True or omitted check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: AsyncTransport notes WSDL loading is still sync (src/zeep/transports.py:176-177); adding async loading is a plausible feature that would reuse the async twin.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Auto-import route that derives a URL from a document-supplied namespace and calls add_document_by_url, which the fix marks _initial=True.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: AUTO_IMPORT_NAMESPACES (src/zeep/xsd/const.py:27) is a list a maintainer might extend or make configurable; the _initial exemption silently covers it.

O9_family: SSRF via transitive external document references (CWE-918)

O10_build.project_tests: tests/test_loader.py and tests/test_xsd_schemas.py (DummyTransport from tests/utils); fix adds 3 loader tests and 1 schema test (fix.diff:239-330)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add an http/https check on settings.forbid_external inside sync load_external only, keeping the default True, which blocks the entry-point WSDL and all default transitive loads while leaving load_external_async and ImportResolver open.

out_of_scope_notes: Redirects followed by requests/httpx on the allowed entry-point fetch (src/zeep/transports.py:144, src/zeep/transports.py:223) can reach any host; not covered by the advisory.
Hardcoded https://www.w3.org/2001/xml.xsd import (src/zeep/xsd/visitor.py:224-225) becomes blocked under forbid_external=True; behaviour change, not a vulnerability.
